title: JEMMA: An Extensible Java Dataset for ML4Code Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Plotting and analyzing the distribution of source lines of code (SLOC) versus cyclomatic complexity to balance training data and prevent models from artificially inflating performance by over-indexing on simple, common methods like getters and setters.

Filtering out cloned and duplicated projects and carefully defining training, validation, and test splits across different projects to prevent models from artificially performing well due to memorizing repeated code.
